newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kohl says unclear what troops would do in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says unclear what troops would do in Albania.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Thursday it was unclear what western troops would do in Albania if sent there to help restore order.
Kohl was anwswering questions from reporters about Albania's request for western military aid.
"If you say we should send troops, then you would have to tell the soldiers what they would do there," Kohl said.
"And if I put this question to you, which I can't answer, then you can see my response."
Kohl was speaking after talks with Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok, whose country holds the European Union presidency during the first half of 1997.

Albanian President Sali Berisha and all the country's political parties had called earlier on Thursday on NATO's European members to provide the military assistance "to restore the constitutional order and to preserve the country's integrity".
